content: Link health conventions from RC/UAV telemetry (ExpressLRS, Crossfire, ArduPilot/SiK): RSSI in dBm plus a separate Link Quality (LQI) percentage of packets actually received are shown together, because RSSI alone doesn't reveal interference-caused packet loss; SiK/RFD900-family radios report RSSI/remote-RSSI in the telemetry stream itself for ground-station display.
